tr_crier: FOUR ROADS! WEST TO THE QUARRY, SOUTH TO THE COAST, NORTH TO NOTHING!
EAST ROAD STILL CLOSED, THIRTY-ONE YEARS AND COUNTING!
...Sorry. Force of habit. You get used to shouting.
tr_drover: Cannot get the herd over the Route 3 bridge. Not one animal.
Had to walk them the long way round, four days.
They know something. Animals always know first.
tr_clerk: Office is open. Ask whatever you like.
That is not me being generous. It is policy. We have nothing to hide and we are very tired of being asked.
tr_child: I am going to be a surveyor.
They get a coat and a brass thing and everyone stops talking when they walk in.
Mum says that is not a reason. It is a bit of a reason.

lines: You are the one Vess sent out? He has been writing to the office here every week.
They keep the letters. They do not answer them.
Go in and see. The Director herself came down two days ago.
You met her, then. Everyone says the same thing after.
That she was reasonable. That is what they always say.

tr_rester: Walked up from Brackwater. Two days and the whole way the sea was flat.
Not calm. Flat. There is a difference and you only learn it once.
tr_shop_hand: Net Vessels are new in. Good for anything that swims.
Which is most of what you will meet south of here.
tr_concord_clerk: No, you may not see the west face readings. Yes, I know that sounds bad.
It is not bad. It is procedure. Those are different things and I am required to say so.
tr_concord_hand: Nine sites this season and not one of them near the coast.
You would think a body that cares about the sea would survey the sea.
...I have said too much. I say that a lot lately.
tr_house: Eighty-one years I have lived at this crossroads.
I remember the last Turning. I was ten. The sea came up the south road as far as the well.
Everyone talks about stopping it now like it is a simple thing.
It is not simple. But I will tell you this: nobody who was there thinks it should be allowed to happen twice.
